name: tiddlywiki-cloudflare-worker
description: TiddlyWiki served by a Cloudflare Worker from R2, with edit-conflict protection, a public cached copy and queued GitHub backups

scripts.lint: eslint src build.mjs tools test eslint.config.js
scripts.test: npm run test:fast && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:fast: npm run build && node test/bake.test.mjs && node test/integrity.test.mjs && node test/r2-ops.test.mjs && node test/cpu.test.mjs && node test/queue-backup.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node test/first-visit.test.mjs && node test/two-tabs.test.mjs && node test/plugins.test.mjs && node test/page-publish.test.mjs && node test/lazy-load.test.mjs
